sentences.text: The reference station predicts high water at ten forty-two, three point six feet, and low water at sixteen fifty, zero point four feet.
The subordinate station’s corrections are plus thirty-five minutes and plus zero point four feet for high water, and plus forty-eight minutes and minus zero point one feet for low water.
So high water at the subordinate station is at eleven seventeen, four point zero feet, and low water is at seventeen thirty-eight, zero point three feet.
In summer, with daylight saving time in effect, add one hour: twelve seventeen and eighteen thirty-eight.
